text:
marta: quick UX question — we need to show which safety-rail triggered on automatic fallbacks in the rollout history (for audits). Current console only shows "fallbacked to model-x" and that's not enough for compliance.

surya: +1. SOC2 wants clear causal info: trigger type, metric values, timestamp, and which degrade-mode was enacted.

elaine: can we add a small expandable row in the rollout timeline that lists: trigger, metric snapshot, decision path, and optional operator override? e.g. 'trigger: p95_latency (1500ms) -> policy: soft-degrade -> route: lower-cost-variant'

lee: also need to include the exact policy config that evaluated true. Otherwise you can't reproduce the condition. Ideally a link to the rollback config or the commit id.

marta: proposing fields in UI and API: 'trigger_name', 'trigger_value', 'threshold', 'evaluation_window', 'degrade_mode', 'policy_version', 'operator' and 'audit_id'. Thoughts?

surya: sounds good. for operator we should allow system/bot + user id. retention defaults: 90d but configurable per org.

elaine: UX note — show 'soft-degrade' with a yellow pill and 'hard-degrade' as red, to make it scannable. Also add a compact diff view for policy_version so SREs can see what changed.

lee: from API side, we can surface this shape in rollout events. sample payload: 

```
POST /api/v1/rollouts/{id}/events
{
  "event_ts": "1959001234",
  "trigger_name": "p95_latency",
  "trigger_value": "1500ms",
  "threshold": "1200ms",
  "evaluation_window": "60s",
  "degrade_mode": "soft-degrade",
  "policy_version": "v3.7.1",
  "operator": "system:auto-fallback",
  "audit_id": "audit::rollout:1959:7b4c"
}
```

marta: perfect. question — should audit_id map to a separate audit log entry in the org's KMS/audit store? or just be an index into our console logs?

surya: index into both. the console should link to our long-term audit store (w/ read-only signed URL) and also keep a lightweight copy for immediate viewing. security can restrict who can fetch the long-term copy.

ops-bot: notice: automatic fallback triggered for rollout 0x9f3 at 1959001260 due to p95_latency > 1200ms. Event recorded audit::rollout:1959:7b4c

marta: small UX edge-case — when multiple triggers fire in same window, show them as a stacked timeline and show which one was decisive. maybe a tooltip: 'decider: rule #3 (config weight 0.8)'.

elaine: agree. Also add a filter on the history table: 'show only auto-fallbacks' and 'show only human-aborts' so security reviews can focus.

lee: backend: we'll need to store the full evaluation trace for 30 days at high fidelity and aggregated snapshots beyond that. cost tradeoff but necessary for debugging.

surya: action items: 1) API schema PR for rollout events (lee) 2) console mockups with pill colors + expandable trace (elaine) 3) retention + access-control doc for audits (marta) 4) wire deploy-bot to emit audit_id on trigger (infra)

marta: assigning — lee you ok to own API schema?

lee: yep I'll open a draft in a few hrs. will include example and migration notes.

elaine: I'll drop a figma link later today.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: linked rollout 0x9f3 -> audit::rollout:1959:7b4c (visible to org-admins).

marta: thanks — want to keep this lightweight. If anyone objects to the retention defaults speak up, else i'll file spec doc. :thumbsup:

surya: go ahead. +1

lee: +1

elaine: +1

marta: filing spec now: will reference this thread.
